Page.Name: page.nav.menubar
Page.Title: Menu bar
Page.Subtitle: On macOS, the first MenuBar of a window is shown in the menu bar of the system, at the top of the screen, while the window is active: look up there (File, Edit, View, Go, Window, Help). Elsewhere it is drawn in the window. Native="false" keeps it in the window everywhere, as below.

Demo.Title: The native menu bar
Demo.Note: Shortcuts are those of the system: Super is Command. Try Cmd+1 to Cmd+5 (Go menu), or View, Theme.
Demo.Label: - **File** - New Window, Open, Open Recent (a sub-menu), Close Window - **Edit** - Undo, Redo, Cut, Copy, Paste, Find Component (`Cmd+F`) - **View** - Theme (every look of Raven), Toggle Dark / Light, Toggle Sidebar - **Go** - jumps to pages, with shortcuts - **Help** - opens links with the action `open:URL`

Demo.Title: In the window: Native="false"
Demo.Note: The same widget, drawn by Raven. Menus open on click and slide between each other on hover.

Demo.Title: Without animation
Demo.Note: Class="noanim": menus open and close at once (demos.c turns Raven's animations off while it is used).
